 Ben Hunt - The Stories that Drive Markets (EP.393) 
 
 Ben Hunt - The Stories that Drive Markets (EP.393) Jun 24, 2024

 Ben Hunt is the creator of Epsilon Theory and co-founder of
Second Foundation Partners, where he writes and invests through the
lens of narratives, or in his words “If a price moves, it is
because a human told themselves a story.” Before turning to
investing twenty years ago, Ben was a
tenured political science professor and founder of two technology
companies. He has been studying trends using what we now call big
data ever since his first book about predicting international
conflict in 1997.

 
 Our conversation
covers  Ben ’s path to finance, the
power of stories, tracking and measuring narratives in markets, and
applying the lens of narrative to investing. Ben ’s insights offer a careful consideration of what’s
really going on in markets.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
